nodes.description: Mapping(uint => address) storing gambler addresses indexed by player_count.
uint8 counter of currently signed-up players.
uint bet amount per player (0.01 ether) in wei.
uint8 number of sign-ups that triggers the lottery draw.
uint8 carry-over player count for the next round.
uint pseudo-random index used to pick the winner.
uint percentage of the pot paid to the winner.
address of the contract owner set in the constructor.
uint block number recorded when the required number of players signed up.
Constructor initializing owner, player_count, ante, required_number_players and winner_percentage.
Owner-only setter for ante, required_number_players and winner_percentage.
Owner-only refund routine that loops transferring ante back to gamblers.
Payable fallback function that accepts bets, checks the ante and executes the draw.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, gambler entry and transfer recipient.
gamblers[player_count].transfer(ante) executed inside an unbounded while loop.
gamblers[1].transfer(this.balance) sweeping the remaining contract balance.
gamblers[random].transfer(ante*required_number_players*winner_percentage/100) paying the winner.
transfer of the house share to hardcoded address 0xBdf8fF4648bF66c03160F572f67722cf9793cE6b.
transfer of the house share to hardcoded address 0xA7aa3509d62B9f8B6ee02EA0cFd3738873D3ee4C.
random = uint(block.blockhash(block.number))%required_number_players + 1, predictable block-derived randomness.
player_count -= 1 executed inside the refund while loop.
player_count += 1 executed on every accepted bet.
while (player_count > required_number_players) loop decrementing player_count and shifting the gamblers mapping.
ante*required_number_players*winner_percentage/100 arithmetic used to compute winner and house payouts.
Parameter newAnte of changeParameters.
Parameter newNumberOfPlayers of changeParameters.
Parameter newWinnerPercentage of changeParameters.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the owner state variable is derived from untrusted caller input.
msg.sender is stored in gamblers and later used as the recipient of the winner transfer, letting an attacker-controlled address receive funds and re-enter.
changeParameters behavior is gated only by msg.sender == owner.
refund is guarded by msg.sender == owner.
The fallback records msg.sender as the gambler entry for the current player_count.
ante is the amount transferred back to the gambler in the refund loop.
ante is the threshold used in the refund loop condition before sweeping this.balance.
ante is a factor of the winner payout amount.
ante is a factor of the house share sent to the first hardcoded address.
ante is a factor of the house share sent to the second hardcoded address.
ante feeds the unchecked multiplication/division payout expression.
player_count indexes gamblers to select the refund recipient.
player_count determines the pot size and mapping state used before the winner transfer.
player_count is incremented when a bet is accepted.
player_count is decremented inside the mapping-shift loop.
player_count is decremented in the refund while loop.
random selects gamblers[random], the recipient of the winner transfer.
required_number_players is used as the modulo bound for the random index.
required_number_players feeds the unchecked payout arithmetic.
required_number_players bounds the while loop that rewrites player_count.
winner_percentage feeds the unchecked payout arithmetic.
bet_blocknumber is compared with block.number to decide whether the draw happens.
bet_blocknumber comparison controls the branch that either draws or throws in the fallback.
Constructor initializes player_count = 0.
Constructor initializes ante = 0.01 ether.
Constructor initializes required_number_players = 5.
Constructor initializes winner_percentage = 90.
Constructor sets the owner state variable.
changeParameters conditionally writes ante.
changeParameters conditionally writes required_number_players.
changeParameters conditionally writes winner_percentage.
Parameter newAnte is written into the ante state variable.
Parameter newNumberOfPlayers is written into required_number_players.
Parameter newWinnerPercentage is written into winner_percentage.
refund loop drives repeated external transfers of ante to gamblers, enabling re-entrancy.
refund performs a final sweep transfer of this.balance to gamblers[1].
refund loop decrements player_count with no lower-bound check, allowing underflow.
fallback computes the winner using predictable block data inside the draw branch.
fallback executes the winner transfer before state finalization, enabling re-entrancy.
fallback executes the first house-share transfer.
fallback executes the second house-share transfer.
fallback increments player_count on each bet without overflow protection.
fallback runs the mapping-shift while loop that decrements player_count.
External transfer inside the refund loop can call back into refund (or the fallback) before player_count is updated.
Final balance sweep transfer can re-enter refund before state changes complete.
Winner transfer invokes an attacker-controlled recipient that can re-enter the payable fallback before player_count is reset.
House-share transfer to a hardcoded address can re-enter the fallback mid-execution.
Second house-share transfer can re-enter the fallback mid-execution.

normalization_plan.reason: newAnte is a changeParameters parameter used only to write the ante state variable inside that function, so it folds into changeParameters.
newNumberOfPlayers is a changeParameters parameter used only to write required_number_players inside that function, so it folds into changeParameters.
newWinnerPercentage is a changeParameters parameter used only to write winner_percentage inside that function, so it folds into changeParameters.
